replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, sometimes I do feel a bit uneasy about it. It's not that I'm afraid, but the subject doesn't come naturally to me. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven't used AI for math learning. As a 60-year-old self-employed man, I rely on traditional methods. I prefer hands-on experiences that I can fully comprehend without digital help.
